subject.title: feat(setup): rename Crestodian to OpenClaw system agent

question: Must protocol-v4 clients and gateways remain cross-version compatible during this rename, or may the change intentionally require lockstep upgrades?
rationale: The branch retains protocol version 4 while removing shipped RPC and capability names, so resolving the upgrade-order breakage requires an explicit compatibility policy rather than routine code cleanup.

options.title: Preserve v4 compatibility
options.body: Keep retired RPC and capability aliases plus client fallbacks until a versioned removal, allowing apps, CLIs, and gateways to upgrade independently.

options.title: Require lockstep upgrades
options.body: Accept mixed-version failures, document the coordinated rollout requirement, and provide concrete rollout and recovery proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve v4 compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep retired RPC and capability aliases plus client fallbacks until a versioned removal, allowing apps, CLIs, and gateways to upgrade independently.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the linked phased proposal and authored the protocol and setup-direction changes that require this decision.
